system.description:
Range 60ft; one creature sees its worst fear. Will negates. On a failed save it must make a Fortitude save: failure reduces it to 0 HP from fright (a player character is unconscious but stable; a monster dies, as at 0 HP); success deals 3d6 psychic damage. Mindless creatures and creatures immune to fear are unaffected.

Classes: Illusionist, Necromancer
system.saveEffect: Negates (on a failure it makes a Fortitude save: failure drops it to 0 HP, success takes 3d6 psychic damage)
